properties.headline: Freeze Warning issued November 13 at 9:33AM CST until November 15 at 8:00AM CST by NWS Birmingham AL
properties.description:
* WHAT...For both Freeze Warnings, sub-freezing temperatures as low
as 28 expected.

* WHERE...All of central Alabama.

* WHEN...For the first Freeze Warning, from midnight tonight to 8 AM
CST Saturday. For the second Freeze Warning, from midnight Saturday
Night to 8 AM CST Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Frost and freeze conditions could kill crops, other
sensitive vegetation and possibly damage unprotected outdoor
plumbing.
properties.instruction:
Take steps now to protect tender plants from the cold.

To prevent water pipes from freezing; wrap or drain or allow them to
drip slowly.

Drain in-ground sprinkler systems and cover above ground pipes.
